## Family calendar digest (demo)
Every morning at 07:00: read several Google calendars -> merge + de-duplicate shared events -> flag overlaps -> **Claude or local Ollama** writes a plain-language digest -> **Gmail draft** (never auto-sent) + **Telegram** message.

Privacy: with Claude, event titles and times leave the house; locations and notes do **not** unless *sendLocationsToCloud* is true. Set *llmProvider* to "ollama" to keep everything local. If the AI is down, a plain digest is sent anyway.
